manifest_status: frozen evaluation contract; B5 locked until T011

generator.name: freeze_protocol_r_evaluation.py
generator.determinism: no generation timestamp; UTF-8 LF JSON; source order is numeric house/chunk

source_dataset.identity: Han preprocessed synchronized REDD submodule CSV chunks

protocol_r.final_development_fit: after method freeze only, B1-B4 may be combined
protocol_r.locked_test_authority: T011 one-time final Protocol R evaluation only

protocol_x.t004_access: source identity and aggregate support audit only; no model evaluation

dependency_contract.containment: all history, future context, lag, rolling state, event pairing, and post-context must remain inside one segment and block
dependency_contract.larger_dependency_policy: requires a new protocol version and manifest

target_contract.missing_column: label unavailable; exclude that house-appliance unit; never impute all-zero ground truth
target_contract.missing_or_non_finite_label: exclude affected target/episode for that appliance and break episode continuity
target_contract.overlap: retain independent multi-label positives when every contributing approved appliance label is observable
target_contract.ambiguous_or_incomplete_episode: exclude from event-level scoring and report exclusion count

binary_classification_contract.scoring_unit: eligible event with an availability mask over appliance labels
binary_classification_contract.decision_rule: signed vote > 0 is positive; signed vote <= 0 is negative
binary_classification_contract.confusion_representation: one TP/FP/FN/TN matrix per appliance over eligible units
binary_classification_contract.accuracy_name: per-appliance binary accuracy; event exact-match accuracy may be reported only where all four labels are observable
binary_classification_contract.macro_rule: unweighted mean over the four frozen appliances; unavailable house-appliance units do not become zero-support classes

regression_contract.target: y_t = max(0, appliance submeter power at row t)
regression_contract.state_threshold_use: 15 W is used only for derived ON/OFF metrics
regression_contract.clipped_prediction_upper_bound: maximum target fitted from the current training blocks only
metrics: pooled NAE (constant-zero prediction is exactly 1 when true energy is positive)
state precision, recall, and F1 at 15 W
error stratified by frozen true-power bins
fraction of raw predictions outside the training target range

ctm_timing_contract.source_episode: inclusive [rise, fall] rows within one segment and block
ctm_timing_contract.event_classification_time: row/time at which the binary class decision is emitted
ctm_timing_contract.post_context_completion_time: fall row/time plus declared post-context D
ctm_timing_contract.model_computation_time: measured compute duration excluding event waiting
ctm_timing_contract.onset_to_output_latency: classification output time minus rise time
ctm_timing_contract.fall_to_output_latency: classification output time minus fall time
ctm_timing_contract.sample_level_backfill: prohibited unless separately defined and validated

metric_and_uncertainty_contract.protocol_x_metrics: separate report; never used for Protocol R model selection
metric_and_uncertainty_contract.weak_support_rule: always report eligible support and exclusions; do not suppress or replace weak units

access_contract.formal_test_entry: future independent T011 command with explicit authority

known_limitations: original calendar timestamps and recording gaps are not recovered
historical raw-to-preprocessed REDD provenance is incomplete
H2/H4 support labels were inspected during T002 and H2/H4 were used by Protocol H compatibility work
Protocol X remains optional and is not a Protocol R model-selection source
